name: bakery-1-post
headline: Scarecrows Had The Final Straw
article: All across our fields, farmers have awoken to a shock, as scarecrows have up and started walking about! Little is known of the scarecrows motives, but they have become territorial of their fields. On the advise of local agricultural and enchantment experts, the farmers guild have agreed to "Burn it all down and send those monsters back to the inferno." Townsfolk are warned they may notice a slight food shortage in the coming weeks, and to avoid wearing any overalls and sun hats for their own protection.

name: bakery-2-post
headline: The Flower Fields
article: Amongst the turmoil of the scarecrow onslaught, a beacon of hope has arrived for our farmers, as our reporters have retrieved an ancient map written in Dryadic, the language of plants. Herbolinguists from the farmers guild have marked out what appears to be the distant homeland of the dastardy scarecrows that are holding our fields hostage. While the translation is unclear, it goes on to describe a 'field of flowers'. A band of adventurers have already embarked to the scarecrows' homeland to take care of this denim clad sourge for good!

name: bakery-3-post
headline: The Flour Fields
article: Our heroes returned from their quest to rid us of the scarecrow scourge, but with bundles of grain, not miracle flowers, in hand. The scent of the delicious grain has calmed the scarecrows, and they agree to go back to their homeland and leave us be. As a parting gift, they left "these weird stuffed dolls on sticks" in their place.

name: quicksave-post
headline: Insane Adventurer "Forgets To Quicksave"
article: An upsetting turn of events today, as well known non-violent hero Paci Fistrun is now from authorities after committing what can only be described as "a horrifying murder spree". Reports claimed he 'got bored and wanted to see what would happen.' The hero released a statement this morning: "I was just fooling around, I meant to reload after, but forgot to quicksave, I swear! Well, there goes this playthrough..."

name: adventure-zone-post
headline: A Zone for Adventure
article: A party of heroes referring to themselves as 'Tres Horny Boys' have stumbled into our little town today, claiming to be hopping from world to world on a century long quest for balance. "Don't ask us what happened to those other worlds!" exclaimed the party diviner, Merle.

name: jarrens-outpost-post
headline: Outpost Hustling
article: Are you looking to hustle? To Rumble? Well come to Jarren's Outpost

name: banned-spells-food
headline: Food Safety Spells
article: Despite ongoing food shortages, the following spells can no longer be cast due to health and safety concerns: • Cheese Whip • Wall of Meat • Flavour Blast

name: princess-1
headline: Princess Out for Revenge
article: Princess Woodsong, who apparently has been captured for six months, has grown tired of waiting for rescue. She was broken out by a band of befriended woodland creatures, who she has trained into a deadly miltia. Now, reports indicate she's out for revenge against the town for forgetting about her. Our correspondent from GuildCo. has reached out to clarify the situation: "We think her ransom note got caught in our spam filter."

name: princess-2
headline: The Woods Last Song
article: The notorious Princess Woodsong and her bloodthirsty band of furry friends have been brought to justice by our brave adventurers. The princess is awaiting trial for her crimes of • Insubordination • Unkemptness • murder If sentenced, she will be locked in 'The Tower', an asylum for runaway princesses.
